ATTENDANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
============================

HOW TO RUN
----------
1. Double-click  Run.bat  OR  Run.vbs

   If Windows shows a security warning:
   - Click "Open" (this only happens the first time)
   - The app will unblock itself automatically after that

   If you still see warnings every time:
   - Right-click Run.bat -> Properties -> Unblock -> OK
   - Then double-click Run.bat

NO INSTALLATION NEEDED
-----------------------
This folder contains everything required.
Do NOT move individual files out of this folder.

FOLDER STRUCTURE
----------------
bin\            Tcl/Tk runtime (wish.exe)
lib\            Tcl/Tk standard library
classes\        Your attendance data (one subfolder per class)
attendance_system_gui.tcl   The main application

FIRST TIME SETUP
----------------
1. Run the application
2. Click "1. Create Class" to create your first class
3. Click "2. Add Student" to import or add students
4. Click "4. Mark Attendance" to start marking

SUPPORT
-------
Source code: https://github.com/kiruthika0612/Attendance_System
